name: Editorial Warm — Monochromatic — Light

teaching.why: Editorial Warm uses a monochromatic relationship while preserving a dominant neutral field. The accent is intentionally much stronger in chroma than the surrounding UI.
avoid: using both accent colors at equal area
using accent as body text without contrast test
adding a third unrelated decorative hue

threeDNotes: Coordinate environment and material lighting with the same temperature family; keep emissive use scarcer than DOM accent.
